title: AetherResourcePack
description: The Main Addon To AetherClientPerformance Mod!, Needed for Buttons/UI colors/gradients and textures.
body: The main resource pack for the AetherClientPerformance Mod is designed to complement the mod by enhancing its overall visual experience while staying true to the original Minecraft style. It adds additional UI texturing and coloring, making menus, overlays, and in-game elements look more refined, consistent, and visually appealing without feeling out of place.
